newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tops life high on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tops life high on fund buying.

text.p: Steady fund buying through commission houses drove London's white sugar futures market to a contract high by the close on Tuesday
October rallied $5.20 to close at an intraday and contract high of $329.90, 20 cents above the previous contract high.
While some trade house buying was featured in the afternoon, the best buyers were said to be commission houses on behalf of fund clients.
"There was some fresh fund buying this morning and more buying this afternoon as well," said one trader.
Some French buying was seen in the London market earlier in the day, thought to be pre-hedging in advance of the weekly European Union tender for export licences.
The December contract finished at $324.00 up $3.80 having traded 371 lots, a volume dwarfed by front month October's 3,322 lots.
In Paris October finished up $4.50 at $328.50 but December dominated the thin trading, up $3.50 at $323.00.
